content.text:
I checked eight claims in the overview against the record, and all of them are supported. None needed a flag.

- **Duration:** "The problem lasted {duration}" is a placeholder, so I didn't judge the figure. I matched only what the sentence says to the figures list and the Impact line.
- **Cost to the business:** the record makes no loss estimate. So "the cost was that shoppers saw wrong figures" is supported only as a plain statement of what shoppers saw (alert finding AL1). It is not supported as a measured cost.
- **The fix:** the Resolution table names the Code-Fix Agent as the one that proposed it. The ask's own list says "Argus: proposed a fix", so crediting Argus is fine. "Has not been put into use" is supported because the record says nothing ran the fix and shows nothing after the draft was opened.

supported.quote: On io-shop, some shoppers' account pages showed spending totals that left out their recent purchases.
rows: AL1
What a reader saw: Shoppers' account pages showed spend totals that left out recent purchases
How long it lasted: at least 41s {duration}
Impact: at least 41s - since the alert, still not back to normal

supported.quote: The saved copies of shoppers' spending totals stopped being updated, and the record does not show why.
rows: AL1
why 2 The cached copies stopped keeping up with the ledger from 00:09 UTC... The record does not show why.

supported.quote: The account page likely showed whatever saved copy it found without checking that it still counted every purchase.
rows: F1
why 3 Nothing on the account page's read side checked a cached figure against the shopper's purchases before showing it.

supported.quote: The cost to the business was that shoppers saw wrong figures about their own spending.
rows: AL1
What a reader saw: Shoppers' account pages showed spend totals that left out recent purchases

supported.quote: Nobody was paged and no on-call responder was called in.
rows: Nobody was paged: no on-call incident was linked to this one.
Contributing factors: The CachedSpendTotalsAreStale alert was not linked to an on-call incident, so nobody was paged.
Response effort: none - engineer time

supported.quote: Argus, the system that responded, discarded io-shop's out-of-date saved figures, and this step was confirmed.
rows: M1
Argus: discarded the stale cached figures of io-shop - confirmed

supported.quote: Argus also proposed a fix, but it is still only a draft and has not been put into use.
rows: Argus: proposed a fix, PR #541 - opened as a draft
The fix it proposed: PR #541 ... opened as a draft. The record holds nothing about it after that.
F1 What Code-Fix read in the source and proposed - nothing ran its test or its fix
